title: The Virgin Birth of Christ
definition: The virgin birth means that Jesus was conceived by the Holy Spirit and born of the virgin Mary.
summary: Jesus' birth was supernatural, fulfilling God's promise and showing that salvation comes by God's initiative.
christFocus: The virgin birth points to Christ as the promised Savior, fully divine and truly human.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Jesus' birth was supernatural, fulfilling God's promise and showing that salvation comes by God's initiative.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
